about_the_game:
What if a classic turn-based strategy became a rogue-lite adventure?

Travel across procedurally generated maps inspired by the landscapes of beloved fantasy worlds. Move between points of interest, conquer foes, recruit a mighty army, and uncover powerful artifacts. Each journey offers new challenges, strategic decisions, and endless replayability.

Endless army composition

Humans and beasts, demons and undead, dragons and orcs—many creatures await to become part of your army. Each unit has unique passive traits and active abilities. Combine them wisely to create the perfect composition and crush your enemies.

Unlock New Content Through Challenges

Complete specific conditions to unlock powerful spells, rare artifacts, and diverse heroes for new adventures. Each hero has unique perks and starting forces—find one to lead your army.

Compete Against Other Players' Avatars

Encounter other players' armies on your journey. Defeat them to earn special rewards and glory, and climb the worldwide leaderboard to prove your strategic mastery.

short_description: A HOMM-like rogue-lite. Gather your army, defeat enemies, and level up your hero. Complete challenges to unlock new content. Experiment with various builds to crush other players' avatars in strategic asynchronous battles.
